name: Motion Wallpaper
author: Gavin Nugent
description: Native looping video wallpaper for omarchy-shell. Renders a muted, looping video on the background layer above the static wallpaper, with per-monitor targeting and auto-pause on fullscreen. Controlled from its bar widget, or from a terminal with the motion-wallpaper CLI.

barWidget.description: Play, pause and pick looping video wallpapers.

service.description: Looping video wallpaper on the background layer.
